description: This source file implements the low-level functions for HTTP authentication backend registration, including managing authentication schemes and backends, initializing and freeing authentication requirements, and matching authentication rules. It appears to be part of the mod_auth_api module in the lighttpd server project.

methods.name: const http_auth_scheme_t * http_auth_scheme_get(const buffer * name)
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to an authentication scheme by name from the static array.

methods.name: void http_auth_scheme_set(const http_auth_scheme_t * scheme)
methods.description: Sets or updates an authentication scheme in the static array.

methods.name: const http_auth_backend_t * http_auth_backend_get(const buffer * name)
methods.description: Retrieves a backend by name from the static array.

methods.name: void http_auth_backend_set(const http_auth_backend_t * backend)
methods.description: Sets or updates an authentication backend in the static array.

methods.name: http_auth_require_t * http_auth_require_init(void)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new http_auth_require_t structure.

methods.name: void http_auth_require_free(http_auth_require_t * const require)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an http_auth_require_t structure.

methods.name: int http_auth_match_rules(const http_auth_require_t * const require,const char * const user,const char * const group,const char * const host)
methods.description: Determines if user, group, or host matches the configured authentication rules.

methods.name: void http_auth_setenv(request_st * const r,const char * username,size_t ulen,const char * auth_type,size_t alen)
methods.description: Sets REMOTE_USER and AUTH_TYPE environment variables in the request header.

methods.name: unsigned int http_auth_digest_len(int algo)
methods.description: Returns the expected digest length based on hashing algorithm.
